messages:
Marta (Marketing): CloudVendor reached out to co-launch in their marketplace + run a joint webinar and benchmark blog. Need owners, deadlines, and lead routing. :wave:

Kevin (Growth): My recommendation: publish a soft marketplace listing ~5 days before the webinar so the event drives installs/traffic. Include a 1-click try flow.

Priya (CloudVendor): We will provide a 2-node perf run, an ops quote, and a deploy link. Artifacts uploaded to the shared folder by Wed EOD.

Alex (PMM): I'll assemble marketplace assets (logo, screenshots, short/long descriptions). Need a final 1-paragraph blurb by next Tue. Also pushing for a short how-to GIF.

Sophia (Content): I'll draft two blog tracks: an engineering-focused benchmark piece and a customer-facing launch post. Can partner confirm test matrix (instance types, dataset, seed prompts)?

Marta (Marketing): Inbound routing plan: webinar registrants -> Pardot list "cloudvendor_webinar"; demo requests -> SFDC queue "CloudVendor_Partners"; marketplace trials -> SFDC record type "MarketplaceTrial". High-intent leads (demo + score >=70) -> webhook to #sales-inbound. Kevin, can Ops set this up?

Kevin (Growth): Ops will create the SFDC queue and assignment rules for NA/EMEA. We'll add a webhook that posts leads meeting the threshold to #sales-inbound.

Alex (PMM): Quickstart snippet for the listing (short):
1) Click "Deploy" on CloudVendor marketplace
2) Choose Redwood plan
3) Paste API key and connect
Partner must enable the deploy link to our demo sandbox.

Priya (CloudVendor): Dev credentials sent via secure share. Security review required; legal boilerplate uploaded to the folder.

Marta (Marketing): Webinar plan (proposal): Date: Tue in two weeks; Format: 30m content + 15m live Q&A; Speakers: Kevin (infra demo), Priya (partner product), Sophia (benchmarks); Dry run 3 business days before event.

Sophia (Content): I'll compile a 10-prompt demo set with expected outputs and a reproducible methodology doc and add them to the artifacts folder.

Marta (Marketing): Lead scoring proposal: demo request + company size >50 => MQL; marketplace trial >3 sessions in 7 days => SAL; webinar attendee + interest => 3-email nurture. Tag SFDC Partner__c = "CloudVendor" and use UTMs: utm_source=cloudvendor, utm_campaign=cloudvendor_launch_may2026, utm_medium=partner.

Legal: Quote and logo usage require review. Marta to open review ticket.

Priya (CloudVendor): We can sign the quote by next Mon. Will confirm once the marketplace blurb is final.

JiraBot: Created ticket MARKETING-4720: "CloudVendor marketplace + webinar execution" assigned to Marta, Kevin, Alex, Sophia. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MARKETING-4720

Marta (Marketing): Action items summary: Kevin = SFDC queue + webhook, demo reliability; Alex = marketplace assets and blurb; Sophia = blog + 10 demo prompts + benchmark doc; Marta = legal coordination + webinar ops; Priya = partner artifacts + creds. Can everyone confirm deliverables by EOD Fri so I can lock the landing page?

Kevin (Growth): Confirmed.

Alex (PMM): Confirmed.

Sophia (Content): Confirmed.

Priya (CloudVendor): Confirmed — excited to launch together! :tada:
